TICKET
# Front controller called in cli is blocked by ssl redirection and maintenance mode

Look at this https://devdocs.prestashop-project.org/8/modules/concepts/controllers/front-controllers/#using-a-front-controller-as-a-cron-task
A cron task in cli can be blocked by ssl redirection and maintenance mode

## Attendu
cli not blocked.
This PR allow front controller like crons tu be launched indifferently by http or by cli.

## Étapes
1. Call a front controller in CLI directly with php like explained in the doc : php patch/myscript.php
2. Activate SSL and Maintenance mode
3. The command doesn't works
